summary: Bounded loop design for the build.sh launcher: dependency reconciliation runs once per invocation, bridge health checks are finite, smoke polling has a strict timeout, and cleanup handles only launcher-owned processes.

loops.purpose: Parse and validate launcher arguments without recurrence.
exit_conditions: All arguments are recognized and mode is selected
Unknown argument triggers usage output and exit
guardrails: No side effects before argument validation succeeds.
Help exits immediately.
Only one mode branch is selected.
loops.feedback_signal: Usage text or normal step logging.
loops.failure_policy: Print usage, exit non-zero, and start no child processes.

loops.purpose: Reconcile Python and frontend readiness for a launcher run.
entry_conditions: Install/build steps are not explicitly skipped
exit_conditions: A dependency or build command fails
guardrails: Run each setup command at most once per launcher invocation.
Frontend dependency install runs only when frontend/node_modules is missing.
A failed setup step exits before starting the web server.
loops.feedback_signal: Step-prefixed terminal messages and command exit status.
loops.state_updates: Reads MEM-002/MEM-003 and updates .venv, frontend/node_modules, and appforge/resources/web when not skipped.
loops.failure_policy: Exit non-zero with the failing command visible; user can fix dependencies and rerun.

loops.purpose: Probe or start llm_bridge only when bridge mode is requested.
exit_conditions: Bun is missing or bridge health timeout expires
guardrails: Do not start bridge for default auto/codex/claude/generic drivers.
Do not kill existing bridge processes not owned by this launcher.
Bound health attempts by APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT.
Write bridge output only to ignored runtime log path.
loops.feedback_signal: Bridge health step messages and .appforge-web/llm-bridge.log for launcher-owned starts.
loops.state_updates: Reads MEM-001/MEM-004; may write MEM-004 log and launcher-owned bridge PID.
loops.failure_policy: If bridge was required, exit before web launch; if explicitly skipped, continue with existing AppForge readiness behavior.

loops.purpose: Run the normal foreground web server until user cancellation.
exit_conditions: appforge web exits with success or failure
guardrails: Use exec for the foreground web server so signal handling is natural.
Default to browser opening unless APPFORGE_NO_OPEN=1 or --no-open.
Do not supervise or restart the server endlessly.
loops.feedback_signal: appforge web terminal output and visible browser UI.
loops.state_updates: Reads MEM-001/MEM-003/MEM-005; existing web app may update .appforge-web after user jobs.
loops.failure_policy: Surface appforge/uvicorn exit code; cleanup launcher-owned bridge process if needed.

loops.purpose: Smoke-test web startup without opening a browser.
exit_conditions: The web process exits before probes pass
guardrails: Force no-browser startup.
Sleep between probes to avoid hot spinning.
Use a bounded timeout and finite attempts.
Kill only launcher-owned web and bridge PIDs in the EXIT trap.
loops.feedback_signal: Probe progress, HTTP status, success/failure line, and process cleanup messages.
loops.state_updates: Reads MEM-005/MEM-006 and writes only process-local probe status plus existing .appforge-web runtime files.
loops.failure_policy: Print failure guidance, cleanup launcher-owned processes, and exit non-zero.

loops.purpose: Validate implementation and release evidence after code edits.
exit_conditions: A gate fails and is fixed within the current work cycle
guardrails: Do not claim a gate passed unless the exact command ran successfully.
Keep failed command output distinct from new fixes.
Do not rerun indefinitely; stop and investigate repeated identical failures.
loops.feedback_signal: Command exit status and AppForge verification/release reports.
loops.state_updates: Writes verification/release artifacts and may refresh packaged web assets through npm build.
loops.failure_policy: Fix actionable failures, otherwise mark the relevant stage blocked with evidence.

retry_budget: Argument parsing runs once. Python/frontend setup commands run at most once per invocation. Bridge health checks use APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT with finite polling. Smoke probes use APPFORGE_SMOKE_TIMEOUT with bounded one-second sleeps. Verification may repeat fix/check cycles up to three times before recording a blocker.
convergence: The launcher converges when normal mode execs the existing appforge web server or smoke mode receives HTTP 200 from both /api/health and /. It exits safely on argument errors, dependency/build failures, required bridge failure, web process exit, or smoke timeout.
human_escape_hatches: Use Ctrl-C to stop normal foreground web mode.
Use APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 and APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 to bypass setup loops in prepared workspaces.
Use APPFORGE_NO_OPEN=1 or --no-open to suppress browser opening.
Use APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE=1 to avoid launcher-owned bridge startup.
Use APPFORGE_WEB_HOST and APPFORGE_WEB_PORT to choose a different loopback endpoint.
observability: Every major loop prints a prefixed status line.
Smoke mode prints success or timeout and the tested URL.
Bridge startup logs are written to .appforge-web/llm-bridge.log when launcher-owned.
Verification reports capture exact commands and pass/fail evidence.

tests.name: smoke-convergence-loop
tests.evidence: APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --smoke proves bounded web probes and cleanup.

tests.name: regression-loop
tests.evidence: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q, npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, and npm --prefix frontend run build pass.

tests.name: docs-loop
tests.evidence: README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md document the launcher behavior and escape hatches.
